The scrambling in the shaft suddenly stops. You hear ragged breathing, then a choked voice - female, young, terrified but trying to focus:
"R-Rostova? You... you found Rostova? Is she...?"
"She didn't make it," you say gently, still descending the ladder. "But she left her service number. She wanted someone to get to the armory. I'm here to help."
There's a long pause. Then the access panel below slowly, cautiously, creaks open. You reach the bottom of the ladder just as a figure tumbles out of the maintenance shaft onto the storage bay floor.
She's human, early twenties, wearing a torn engineering jumpsuit with the name "CHEN" on the patch. Her face is pale, streaked with grime and tears, and there's dried blood on her temple. She's clutching her left arm to her chest - it hangs at an wrong angle. She looks up at you with wide, terrified eyes that slowly focus on your Vexian features, then your uniform.
"You're... you're real," Chen whispers. "You're not one of those things. Oh god, I thought... I've been hiding for... I don't know how long. The things in the vents, they killed Martinez, they killed everyone, I saw them pull Martinez up into the—"
She's starting to hyperventilate, edging toward panic again.
You're in the storage bay now. The Plasma Injector cabinet is visible across the room. Chen needs medical attention, but she also might know crucial information about what happened here.

You kneel beside Chen, pulling out your medical scanner with one hand while rifling through your supplies with the others. "I'm going to help you," you say calmly. "I've got medical supplies. Just keep talking to me - tell me what happened while I work."
You activate the scanner, its blue light washing over Chen as she flinches instinctively.

Dislocated left shoulder
Mild concussion
Dehydration
Elevated stress hormones
No biological contamination detected

"This is going to hurt," you warn, pulling out one of your Synth-Flesh applicators. "But I need to reset your shoulder first."
"Wait, wait—" Chen gasps, but you've already positioned your four hands - two to hold her steady, two to manipulate the joint.
Roll a Medicine check (d20 + your Wisdom modifier of +1) to see how well you handle the medical treatment. Or if you'd prefer, you could use Intelligence instead, approaching it like an engineering problem.
While you prepare, Chen starts talking through gritted teeth: "Three days ago... maybe four? The Captain brought something aboard from a derelict we found. Said it was... was valuable salvage. But the container breached in the cargo bay. These things... they got Ramirez first. Then they spread through the vents."
She shudders. "Martinez and I sealed ourselves in here, but they found us. Pulled him right up into the vent. I've been hiding in the maintenance shaft since, drinking condensation, trying not to make a sound. There's... there's more than one. At least three, maybe more."

She points toward the Plasma Injector cabinet. "That's what you're here for, right? To fix the reactor? Martinez and I tried to get to it, but..." she shudders. "The vents in here aren't webbed, but they're not sealed either. Every time we made noise, we heard clicking from above."
Sure enough, looking up, you see the storage bay's ceiling vents are clear of webbing but dark and open. The room has been quiet so far, but Chen's scream when you reset her shoulder was loud.
